{{Quote|It's ''them,'' Luke. The ''Empire&hellip; they're here.''<nowiki></nowiki>|Jorin Sol to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="r4">[[Rebellion 4|''Rebellion'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Tingel Deepspace Besh''' was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]]-coordinate location. Nine months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the bulk of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Rebel Alliance Fleet]] took up sanctuary at Deepspace Besh, only to have its location betrayed to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], leading to an [[Disaster at Deepspace Besh|ambush]] in which the Alliance Fleet was heavily devastated.

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places Deepspace Besh in grid square P-13,<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" />
